copy: Acme Sync Pro now costs $12 per user per month. Every plan includes SSO. Files sync in under 2 seconds on average. Pro customers get 24/7 phone support. Offline mode is available on iOS and Android.

docs.text:
Acme Sync pricing (October 2026).

Pro costs $15 per user per month, billed annually.

SSO is included on the Business and Enterprise plans only.

Acme Sync pricing (March 2026).

Pro costs $12 per user per month, billed annually.

SSO is included on the Business and Enterprise plans only.

Release 4.2.

Median sync time dropped to 2.4 seconds.

Offline mode is now available on iOS. Android support is planned.

Pro support: email support with a 24-hour response target.
